title: auth_unauthenticated_redirect_and_register_404
description: Verify unauthenticated GET /home /dashboard /users /master-sync /gudang/1/stok redirect to /login (302). GET /register returns 404. POST /login without CSRF returns 419.

title: auth_login_all_roles_valid_credentials
description: Login each test account via HTML _token: SuperAdmin test@example.com/admin, AdminPPE adminppe@example.com/password123, HSE hse@example.com/password123, Manager manager@example.com/password123, AdminPPE2 adminppe2@example.com/password123. Each must reach GET /home with 200.

title: users_superadmin_only_access
description: SuperAdmin GET /users returns 200 HTML. AdminPPE Manager HSE GET /users must redirect to /home (302). Unauthenticated GET /users redirects to /login.

title: master_sync_superadmin_only
description: SuperAdmin GET /master-sync returns 200. AdminPPE HSE Manager GET /master-sync redirect to /home (302).

title: gudang_idor_unauthorized_warehouse
description: adminppe@example.com (gudang 1 only) GET /gudang/2/masuk redirects to /home (302). adminppe2@example.com (gudang 2 only) GET /gudang/1/masuk redirects to /home (302). SuperAdmin can enter both.

title: gudang_authorized_masuk_sets_session
description: adminppe@example.com GET /gudang/1/masuk then GET /dashboard returns 200. adminppe2@example.com GET /gudang/2/masuk then GET /dashboard returns 200.

title: dashboard_requires_gudang_session
description: After login without entering gudang, GET /dashboard redirects to /home (302). After /gudang/1/masuk, GET /dashboard returns 200 HTML.

title: stok_view_and_crud_by_role
description: Enter gudang 1. AdminPPE and SuperAdmin GET /gudang/1/stok 200. Manager HSE GET /gudang/1/stok 200 (view). Manager POST /gudang/1/stok redirects /home (302). HSE POST /gudang/1/stok redirects /home (302). AdminPPE POST with valid CSRF should succeed or redirect not home.

title: personel_view_and_crud_by_role
description: Enter gudang 1. All roles GET /gudang/1/personel 200. Manager POST /gudang/1/personel redirects /home. AdminPPE GET 200.

title: transfer_barang_access_by_role
description: Enter gudang 1. AdminPPE SuperAdmin GET /gudang/1/transfer-barang 200. Manager GET 200 view. Manager POST redirects /home.

title: ppe_masuk_keluar_view_all_roles
description: Enter gudang 1. All roles GET /gudang/1/ppe-masuk and /gudang/1/ppe-keluar return 200.

title: pemakaian_ppe_view_all_roles
description: Enter gudang 1. All roles GET /gudang/1/pemakaian-ppe returns 200.

title: permintaan_buat_admin_only
description: Enter gudang 1. AdminPPE SuperAdmin GET /gudang/1/permintaan/buat-tabel 200. Manager HSE GET redirect /home (302).

title: permintaan_list_view_by_role
description: Enter gudang 1. All roles GET /gudang/1/permintaan 200 (view access).

title: mobilisasi_view_and_create_by_role
description: Enter gudang 1. All roles GET /gudang/1/mobilisasi 200. Manager HSE GET /gudang/1/mobilisasi/create redirect /home. AdminPPE GET create 200.

title: demobilisasi_view_by_role
description: Enter gudang 1. All roles GET /gudang/1/demobilisasi 200.

title: approval_demob_hse_superadmin_only
description: Enter gudang 1. HSE SuperAdmin GET /gudang/1/approval-demob 200. AdminPPE Manager GET redirect /home (302).

title: peminjaman_ppe_access_by_role
description: Enter gudang 1. All roles GET /gudang/1/peminjaman-ppe 200. AdminPPE Manager view only POST redirect /home. HSE POST with CSRF allowed.

title: home_shows_gudang_access_flags
description: adminppe@example.com GET /home HTML contains gudang 1 accessible and gudang 2 not accessible (bisa_akses or Tidak ada akses text).

title: csrf_protection_on_post
description: Authenticated session POST /gudang/1/stok without _token returns 419.
